name: build-deals
description: The user's AI-video build (2026-10-30): one RTX 5060 Ti 16GB + a Lenovo P520 or HP Z4 G4 with 64GB RAM or more, two x16 slots for a 2nd GPU later, total <= $1,000 with Miami-Dade tax. Runs every 6 hours (06:00, 12:00, 18:00 - never midnight-6 AM) from Windows Task Scheduler (run-build-deals.bat). An offer at or under a product's deal_price gets a check mark and goes in the opportunity banner at the top of the dashboard; eBay auctions only when bid + shipping is under it and they end within 24 h (a bid is not a price). Selectable eBay listings never count at their 'from' price: config_check.py selects the 64GB options on the listing page and records the price the page then shows.

RTX 5060 Ti 16GB._deal_rule: deal_price 450: with a 64GB workstation at ~420 the build stays near $1,000 with tax. The user wants a native 8-pin, dual-slot card (Zotac Twin Edge/AMP 220.5 mm, MSI Ventus/Shadow 2X 227 mm, Gigabyte Windforce 208 mm / Eagle 215 mm); 16-pin or large models are flagged, not hidden.

Lenovo P520 (64GB+)._deal_rule: every P520 supply (690/900/1000W) has two 8-pin GPU cables and takes a 2nd card (Lenovo Power Configurator v1.6); the P520c (single GPU) is rejected

1TB NVMe SSD._rule: the build's required 1TB NVMe drive when the workstation has none; no deal banner (no deal_price)

HP Z4 G4 (64GB+)._deal_rule: HP QuickSpecs: the 465W supply has no GPU cables; 750W = one card through a 6-to-8-pin adapter; 1000W = two cards (with HP's card-guide kit). Check the supply before buying.
